name: That Freekick Challenge
creator: NelStud
redeem: Launch That Freekick Challenge on Roblox and finish the tutorial.
Click the Misc. button in the top-left corner, then open Settings.
Scroll to the bottom of the Settings menu to find the Enter Code box.
Paste a code and press Redeem.
notes:
That Freekick Challenge is a free kick sandbox game on Roblox made by NelStud. You pick a spot on the pitch, set up the wall, then adjust power, angle, rotation and curve before you strike. You can practice on your own or challenge other players, and coins buy cards that raise stats like Accuracy, Precision, Power and Curl.

Codes here give coins and the odd Perk Point. Coins are the most useful reward because they go straight into cards that make your shots better, while Perk Points unlock skills that help on hard kicks. NelStud has posted new codes around player and visit milestones and with updates, with names like TFC15M pointing to visit counts, and they show up in the NelStud Discord first.

codes.reward: Free reward for a limited number of players, so it may already be used up

faq.q: Why can't I find the code box in That Freekick Challenge?
faq.a: It sits at the very bottom of Settings, which you open from the Misc. button in the top-left. It only works once you have finished the tutorial.

faq.q: Should I spend code coins or Perk Points first?
faq.a: Put coins into cards for the stat you miss most, usually Accuracy or Curl. Save Perk Points for a skill that helps with the shots you struggle on.
It was only for a limited number of players, so it may already be used up. If it says invalid, the other codes on this list still work.

tips: When a shot misses, change only one setting at a time. Adjusting power, angle, rotation and curve together makes it hard to tell what went wrong.
Set up the wall the way you find hardest and practice alone before you challenge other players with the same setup.
Try free kicks from different spots on the pitch, not only your favorite one. Each spot needs different settings to score.
When a setup scores, remember the power and curve you used from that spot. Repeating what works is faster than guessing each time.
useRewards: The working coin codes add up to 410,000 Coins, plus one Perk Point from PERKSSSS. That is enough to buy several cards at once, so redeem them together and plan what to buy before you spend. Try KNUCKL3 right away, since it only works for a limited number of players. Hold the Perk Point until you know which kind of kick needs the most help.
